_comment: ÄKTA link. 'mode' is sim | hardware | off. Values use UNICORN logic for the I/O-box E9: 1 = open circuit, 0 = closed. OPC UA node ids are PLACEHOLDERS: discover them with  python -m akta_autosampler.tools.opcua_browse <endpoint>

run_state.description: UNICORN run state (Running / Hold / Pause / End)

sample_request.description: ÄKTA Digital out 1 (D-sub pin 6, pin 5 = ground). 0 = ÄKTA ready for sample

needle_ready.description: ÄKTA Digital in 1 (D-sub pin 1). 0 = needle is in the vial
